newsitem.title: USA: US CORPORATE BONDS - Prices ride Treasury see-saw.
newsitem.headline: US CORPORATE BONDS - Prices ride Treasury see-saw.

text.p: U.S. corporate bond prices tracked Treasuries in a roll-coaster session on Tuesday, but trading volume remained modest, corporate traders said.
Spreads on high-grade bonds were mostly unchanged, although traders reported some spread-widening among intermediate maturity credits due to the unusually high-price of the five-year Treasury.

Junk bond prices rose modestly in the morning echoing strength in the underlying Treasury market, but weakened after Treasuries stumbled in the afternoon. High-yield traders said prices finished the day mostly unchanged.
